nodes.description: Owner address state variable; controls privileged functions getOwner/setOwner/airdrop.
Address of the last non-contract holder that receives minted rewards on each transfer/transferFrom.
Ratio (default 1) used to compute the burn amount on every transfer: value * burnRatio / 100.
Hard cap of 1000e18 tokens that bounds the minting performed by _valueToMint.
payable constructor: sets owner and lastHodler to msg.sender and mints 100e18 initial supply.
Public view returning the current owner address.
Owner-restricted setter that transfers ownership to an arbitrary address.
Owner-restricted function performing a hard-coded batch of _mint calls to many addresses.
Overridden ERC20 transfer: burns a ratio of the value, forwards the rest, mints a reward to lastHodler and updates lastHodler.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom: burns a ratio of the value, forwards the rest, mints a reward to lastHodler and updates lastHodler.
Private view computing the mint amount: 1e18 unless remaining supply to maxSupply is lower.
Private view using assembly extcodesize to detect whether an address is a contract.
Inherited GSN helper returning msg.sender.
Caller-controlled origin of every external call; used for ownership and lastHodler assignment.
Composite operation inside transfer: super.transfer, super.burn, _mint to lastHodler and lastHodler state update executed in sequence.
Composite operation inside transferFrom: super.transferFrom, super.burnFrom, _mint to lastHodler and lastHodler state update executed in sequence.
Inline assembly extcodesize check; size is 0 for contracts under construction and for destroyed accounts.
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer, split into burn and final value.
Source account parameter of transferFrom whose tokens are burned.
Recipient parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, split into burn and final value.
New owner address assigned to the owner state variable.
Computed burn amount in transfer: _value.mul(burnRatio).div(100).
Amount actually forwarded in transfer: _value.sub(toBurn).
Computed burn amount in transferFrom: _value.mul(burnRatio).div(100).
Amount actually forwarded in transferFrom: _value.sub(toBurn).
Remaining mintable supply: maxSupply - totalSupply().
uint32 size read from extcodesize of the checked address.

edges.reason: msg.sender in the constructor is written into the owner state variable, granting full control of the contract.
msg.sender is stored as lastHodler during construction.
The _onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner, gating the setOwner state transition.
The _onlyOwner modifier gates the airdrop minter, so msg.sender controls arbitrary minting.
transfer executes the burn/transfer/mint composite operation.
transferFrom executes the burnFrom/transferFrom/mint composite operation.
_value is multiplied by burnRatio and divided by 100 to derive toBurn.
burnRatio state variable feeds the burn computation in transfer.
toBurn is subtracted from _value to obtain finalValue.
_value is the minuend of the finalValue computation.
toBurn is passed to super.burn inside the composite transfer operation.
finalValue is forwarded through super.transfer inside the composite operation.
Recipient _to is used both as super.transfer target and as the new lastHodler.
The composite operation writes _to into lastHodler after the burn/mint calls.
transfer calls the _isContract extcodesize check before updating lastHodler.
transfer calls _valueToMint to determine the reward minted to lastHodler.
Token burn/mint and lastHodler update happen after the value transfer routine, so a malicious recipient/ERC20 hook could re-enter transfer before state is final.
_value is multiplied by burnRatio and divided by 100 to derive toBurn in transferFrom.
burnRatio feeds the burn computation in transferFrom.
toBurn is subtracted from _value to obtain finalValue in transferFrom.
_value is the minuend of the finalValue computation in transferFrom.
toBurn is passed to super.burnFrom inside the composite transferFrom operation.
finalValue is forwarded through super.transferFrom inside the composite operation.
_from is burned and debited by the composite transferFrom operation.
_to is credited by the composite operation and can become the new lastHodler.
transferFrom writes _to into lastHodler after burn/mint interactions.
transferFrom calls _isContract before updating lastHodler.
transferFrom calls _valueToMint for the reward amount.
transferFrom performs burnFrom/mint and only then updates lastHodler, allowing re-entrant transferFrom before state finalization.
_valueToMint reads maxSupply to bound the minted amount.
remaining is computed as maxSupply - totalSupply(), a raw subtraction.
_isContract assigns the extcodesize result to the local size variable.
The assembly extcodesize result feeds the unsafe contract-detection operation.
The extcodesize comparison result controls the boolean returned by _isContract.
The new address parameter is written into the owner state variable.
setOwner consumes the caller-supplied address to reassign contract ownership.
setOwner mutates the owner state variable, changing privileged access rights.
getOwner reads the owner state variable.
_msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller.
transfer relies on _msgSender for the effective caller.
transferFrom relies on _msgSender for allowance accounting.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer, so it collapses into the transfer function node.
The _value parameter is fully consumed by the burn/forward/mint sequence inside transfer.
The _from parameter is only used by the transferFrom burn/mint sequence.
The _to parameter is only used by the transferFrom burn/mint sequence.
The _value parameter is fully consumed by the transferFrom burn/mint sequence.
The _address parameter exists solely to be assigned by setOwner, so it merges into that function.
toBurn is an intermediate of the burn computation performed by the transfer unsafe operation.
finalValue is an intermediate of the transfer unsafe operation.
toBurn is an intermediate of the burn computation inside transferFrom.
finalValue is an intermediate of the transferFrom unsafe operation.
remaining is a transient calculation local to _valueToMint.
size is a transient local only used for the extcodesize comparison in _isContract.
